title: Fix missing Shadcn UI imports by adding a local UI kit and updating all @/components/ui/* references

requirements.text: Resolve the build error caused by missing imports under `@/components/ui/*` by replacing all such imports across the frontend with imports from a new, non-immutable local UI kit directory (for example `@/components/ui-kit/*`).

quotes:
There seems to be a missing ui directory.
Error: The following dependencies are imported but could not be resolved:

  @/components/ui/sonner ...
  @/components/ui/button ...
  @/components/ui/card ...
  @/components/ui/badge ...
  @/components/ui/alert-dialog ...
  @/components/ui/dialog ...
  @/components/ui/input ...
  @/components/ui/label ...
  @/components/ui/textarea ...
  @/components/ui/select ...
  @/components/ui/radio-group ...
  @/components/ui/alert ...

acceptanceCriteria: No source file in `frontend/src` imports from `@/components/ui/*` anymore.
The app compiles without unresolved-import errors for UI components.
All updated imports use a consistent new prefix (e.g. `@/components/ui-kit/...`).

requirements.text: Create the missing UI component implementations in the new UI kit directory to match the APIs currently used by the app: `button`, `card`, `badge`, `alert`, `dialog`, `alert-dialog`, `input`, `label`, `textarea`, `select`, and `radio-group` (including the subcomponents referenced in the code, such as `CardHeader`, `DialogContent`, `SelectItem`, etc.).
acceptanceCriteria: All pages/components that previously depended on Shadcn-style UI primitives render without runtime crashes.

The newly added UI components provide the specific exports used in files like `frontend/src/components/transactions/TransactionFormDialog.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/vendors/DeleteVendorGuard.tsx`, and `frontend/src/pages/TransactionsPage.tsx` (e.g. `Dialog`, `DialogContent`, `AlertDialogAction`, `SelectTrigger`, `RadioGroupItem`, etc.).
UI components apply Tailwind classes so existing className usage in the app continues to produce a usable layout in both light and dark mode.

requirements.text: Remove the dependency on the missing `@/components/ui/sonner` wrapper by switching to a working Toaster import and usage, ensuring toast notifications continue to display (the app currently calls `toast.success`/`toast.error`).
acceptanceCriteria: A toaster is mounted once at the app root, and existing calls like `toast.success('...')` still display notifications.

constraints: Do not edit anything under `frontend/src/components/ui` (it is an immutable/read-only path in this environment).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Redesigning app screens or changing business logic; only fix missing UI primitives/imports to restore a working build.
